snippet.title: The 18th Attic - Official Gameplay Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the latest gameplay trailer for The 18th Attic, a psychological horror game where you play as a man trapped in the attic with your cat, and your only armed with a camera. You will need to hunt down paranormal anomalies by taking their pictures, all while discovering the secrets of your past. The 18th Attic will be released on PC in Q4 2025.
